messages:
emily: Quick heads-up - opened a small PR to adjust the region availability table and update an SDK snippet for geo endpoints. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4123 :wave:

mike: Nice. Is this just text changes or do we need a migration guide for customers?

emily: Mostly text + one code snippet change. But we should add a 1-line migration note in the SDK section — some customers still use the old `region` param in examples.

sarah: Paste the snippet and I'll incorporate it and run the link-checker.

emily: Sure. Current example uses the old path. Updating to the new endpoint param and showing the recommended SDK pattern.

emily: ```js
// old
client.generate({ model: 'x-large', region: 'eu' })

// new (recommended)
client.generate({ model: 'x-large', endpoint: 'https://eu.api.redwood.ai' })
```

alex: That new form is correct. Also add a note: Dedicated customers should pin model version + region in the Console rather than passing endpoint in code.

mike: Agree. Also please add a short data residency line: "requests to EU endpoints keep logs in EU by default" — legal asked for explicit wording.

emily: Drafted: "Data processed through our EU endpoints is logged and stored within EU regions unless your account is configured for a different residency; contact support for bespoke contracts."

sarah: Good. Wrap into a callout and link to the residency FAQ at /residency.

emily: Added: "See https://docs.redwood.ai/residency#data-residency-eu for details and legal caveats." Updated APAC latency note (~20-80ms).

docs-bot: link-checker found failing link: https://docs.redwood.ai/residency#data-residency-eu -> 404 (PR branch).

emily: The anchor changed on main. I'll fix the link in the PR and push.

alex: Tip — use a more stable anchor or link to the section title; ops ok with the migration window?

mike: Ops ok with 60 days. Add migration note in PR description and deprecation timeline.

sarah: I'll review after the link fix. If small, we can merge and cherry-pick the APAC note to the 1.2 release notes.

emily: Pushed fix and updated PR description with migration note + changelog draft. https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4123

docs-bot: link-checker passed on latest push. :white_check_mark:

mike: Anyone want a brief curl example for non-SDK clients?

emily: Added curl example in PR body:

emily: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"x-large","input":"Hello"}'
```

sarah: LGTM. I'll merge after CI and cherry-pick to release branch.

alex: I'll file REDWOOD-SDK-789 for the deprecation warning and follow up with SDK owners.

emily: Thanks all, merging after CI. Will ping infra if follow-ups. :rocket:
